review_candidates.title: Quality Engineer
review_candidates.description: The Opportunity We are seeking a proactive and results-oriented Engineer to drive a culture of Quality Excellence and Continuous Improvement across the Local Service Unit (LSU). In this role, you will champion quality strategies, processes, and improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance, strengthen customer satisfaction, and support sustainable business growth. You will be responsible for developing and optimizing management systems, tools, and best practices that enable consistent execution, data-driven decision-making, and long-term performance improvement. Working collaboratively across functions, you will lead transformative initiatives that embed quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement into the organization's daily operations, ensuring customer expectations are consistently met or exceeded. How You Will Make An Impact Quality Leadership & Governance Act as a role model to promote a culture of Quality and Continuous Improvement (Q&CI). Lead and coordinate the deployment of BU/Hub Q&CI initiatives and the Hub Q&CI Plan within the LSU. Advocate for the customer's voice in quality-related decisions and business processes. Communicate Quality & CI KPIs across the LSU and provide regular performance updates. Report KPI performance, improvement actions, and Q&CI progress to LSU and Hub leadership. Customer Experience & Continuous Improvement Ensure compliance with the T-NPS process, including customer feedback collection, analysis, action planning, and feedback closure. Coordinate the resolution and escalation of customer complaints and issues. Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) activities for customer concerns, KPI deviations, failures, and non-conformances. Drive implementation of corrective, preventive, and improvement actions. Foster a learning culture through lessons learned, best practice sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives. Contribute to the Hub Roadmap, annual Continuous Improvement Plan, lighthouse initiatives, and project savings targets. Quality Management System, Assurance & Compliance Establish, implement, maintain, and continuously improve the Local Quality Management System (ADONIS). Plan and coordinate Management Review Meetings and ensure periodic reviews of QMS effectiveness. Ensure process sustainability through collaboration with process owners and development of appropriate metrics. Lead internal and external audit planning, execution, and follow-up activities. Collaborate with Project Managers to ensure customer requirements are accurately captured in Project Quality Plans. Ensure compliance with quality standards, customer requirements, and organizational processes. Quality Performance Monitoring & Control Ensure effective quality controls are in place to meet customer, project, and service requirements. Participate in Project Reviews to monitor execution and identify quality risks and issues. Analyze Quality & CI KPIs, including CoPQ, COTD, T-NPS, NCR, and Failure Cost Rate. Drive performance improvement initiatives based on KPI trends and RCA outcomes. Monitor implementation and effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions. Capability Development & Training Assess Quality & Continuous Improvement competencies within the LSU and identify training needs. Deliver quality-related training and awareness programs as required and develop, maintain, and continuously improve onboarding and training materials. Support the achievement of Lean Six Sigma (L6S) certification objectives and capability-building initiatives within the LSU. Your Background Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related discipline. Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in Quality Management, Quality Assurance, Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, or a related field. Knowledge of Quality Management System (QMS) standards, including ISO 9001, ISO/TS 16949, Six Sigma, and related quality frameworks. Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification preferred. Strong understanding of data analytics, statistics, and quality improvement methodologies and tools, including Fishbone Diagram, DMAIC, 8D, A3, PDCA, and 5W2H. Experience in conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA), managing corrective and preventive actions, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret quality and performance data to identify trends and improvement opportunities. Effective stakeholder management, collaboration, and influencing skills across multiple functions and organizational levels. Proficiency in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to plan, lead, and facilitate audits, training programs, and quality governance activities. review_candidates.title: People & Culture Manager
review_candidates.description: Location:  Cairo, Egypt Department:  People & Culture Reports to:  Managing Director About everbrand & co. everbrand & co. is an integrated marketing and communications agency established in 2015. We work with leading local and international organizations across corporate, energy, technology, tourism, hospitality and other sectors, creating meaningful brand experiences through communications, events, branding, content and creative. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a  People & Culture Manager  to help us build an environment where people can do their best work, develop professionally and feel connected to the agency and to one another. This role combines  people, culture, organizational development, internal communication, learning and workplace administration . The Role The People & Culture Manager will be responsible for creating and maintaining a positive, structured and engaging employee experience at everbrand & co. The role will ensure that our  culture is intentional, our people are supported, our teams communicate effectively and our workplace operates to a high standard . You will work closely with agency leadership and department heads to understand organizational needs, identify opportunities for improvement and translate them into practical people and culture initiatives. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable  working with people, developing programs, improving processes and making sure things actually happen. Key Responsibilities 1. People & Culture Translate the agency's values into meaningful employee experiences, behaviors and internal initiatives. Develop initiatives that strengthen employee engagement, belonging, motivation and collaboration. Create programs that recognize achievements, celebrate milestones and make people feel valued. Develop and maintain employee engagement activities throughout the year. Identify cultural or organizational issues and work with management to address them constructively. Act as a trusted point of contact for employees while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and professionalism. Support management in creating a healthy, respectful and collaborative working environment. 2. Internal Communication Own and develop the agency's  internal communication program . This includes: Developing an internal communications calendar and annual plan. Ensuring employees are kept informed about important company news, developments, achievements and changes. Developing internal newsletters, announcements, campaigns and employee communications. Creating initiatives that improve communication between departments and levels of the organization. Supporting leadership communication and ensuring important messages are communicated clearly and consistently. Developing internal campaigns around agency values, culture, achievements and strategic priorities. Creating opportunities for employees to share ideas, feedback and success stories. The goal is not simply to  communicate information , but to create a stronger sense of  connection, alignment and belonging . 3. Organizational Development Support the agency's leadership in developing the organization as it grows. Responsibilities include: Reviewing organizational structures, roles and responsibilities as needed. Supporting the development and updating of job descriptions. Identifying organizational gaps, overlaps and opportunities for greater efficiency. Supporting the development of career paths and progression frameworks. Helping define competencies and expectations for different roles. Supporting performance management and appraisal processes. Identifying opportunities to improve collaboration between departments. Supporting succession planning and talent development where relevant. Gathering employee feedback and translating insights into organizational improvements. Supporting leadership with people-related data and organizational insights. 4. Learning & Development Own the agency's internal learning and development agenda. This includes: Identifying training and development needs across teams. Developing an annual training and development plan. Coordinating internal and external training programs. Organizing workshops, knowledge-sharing sessions and learning initiatives. Supporting managers in identifying development opportunities for their teams. Establishing mechanisms to track training participation and effectiveness. Encouraging knowledge sharing across departments. Helping employees identify relevant skills and capabilities for their professional growth. Developing internal learning initiatives using the expertise already available within the agency. Where appropriate, the role should help create a culture where  people teach, learn and grow from one another , rather than relying exclusively on external training. 5. Employee Experience Take ownership of the overall employee experience from joining the agency through to development and progression. This includes: Improving the onboarding experience for new employees. Developing structured onboarding materials and programs. Ensuring employees understand the agency, its culture, values, ways of working and expectations. Coordinating employee milestones and key moments throughout the employee journey. Developing employee recognition initiatives. Identifying recurring employee concerns and recommending improvements. Supporting offboarding and conducting exit interviews where appropriate. Maintaining a strong understanding of employee sentiment and organizational dynamics. 6. Office Administration & Workplace Quality Oversee the  administrative quality and overall functioning of the office , ensuring that the workplace supports the team and reflects the standards of the agency. This includes: Overseeing the office/ facilities team to ensure the office is organized, functional, welcoming and properly maintained. Supervising office supplies, facilities and day-to-day administrative requirements. Ensuring administrative processes are documented and followed. Monitoring office-related issues and ensuring timely resolution. Supporting workplace policies and procedures. Ensuring employees have the tools, information and environment they need to work effectively. Reviewing administrative processes periodically and identifying opportunities for improvement. Maintaining appropriate records and documentation related to people and office administration. Coordinating office arrangements for meetings, employee activities and internal events. The expectation is  not to personally handle every administrative task , but to ensure that the office operates smoothly and that the relevant responsibilities are properly managed. 7. Policies & People Processes Develop, document and maintain internal people policies and procedures. Ensure employees understand relevant policies and ways of working. Continuously review policies to ensure they remain practical and relevant to the agency. Maintain appropriate employee documentation and records. Work with management and relevant external HR/legal advisors when specialized support is required. Ensure people-related processes are consistent and professionally managed. What Success Looks Like A successful People & Culture Manager will help create an agency where: People understand the agency's direction and values. Employees know what is expected of them. Communication is clear and consistent. People feel connected to the organization. Employees have opportunities to learn and develop. Good performance is recognized. Managers are better equipped to lead their teams. Organizational issues are identified early and addressed constructively. The office operates smoothly and professionally. Internal processes are structured without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. The employee experience reflects the quality and personality of everbrand & co. The Person We're Looking For We are looking for someone who is  people-oriented, organized, mature and proactive , with the ability to balance empathy with structure. You should have: 7+ years of experience in HR, People & Culture, Organizational Development, Employee Experience or a related field. Experience in a creative, marketing, communications or similarly fast-paced environment is highly desirable. Strong understanding of organizational development and employee engagement. Experience developing internal communication and employee engagement programs. Experience in training and learning & development. Strong organizational and project management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence. Ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters with maturity and discretion. Ability to work with both senior leadership and employees at all levels. Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture. Good English and Arabic communication skills. A practical, hands-on approach and the ability to turn ideas into implemented initiatives.
